resources.string: Use this tool only when the current Rime directory uses a Wanxiang scheme. Other schemes do not need this feature.
Edit scheme settings, custom phrases and spelling rules.
Updates the scheme and dictionaries, selected extra dictionaries, and the grammar model. The model download may be large.
Updates the selected scheme. Dictionaries and the grammar model stay unchanged.
Updates dictionaries and any selected extra dictionaries. The scheme and model stay unchanged.
Downloads the LTS grammar model. This may use a significant amount of data.
Choose at least one dictionary below. Files come from the official GitHub repository; Pro conversion uses the character table in the current directory.
The selected files are protected by your current rules. No files were installed or redeployed.
For Wanxiang users only: update schemes, dictionaries and models in the current directory
The update directory appears when the task starts. Switching directories does not change the target of a queued task.
Uses the active directory in Rime settings. Downloads continue when you leave this page.
Dictionaries use the rolling release; the grammar model uses LTS. The scheme channel applies to scheme downloads.

Rime redeploys after updates. Protection rules control existing configuration and dictionary resources; user databases, sync and runtime data are always protected. A full update also downloads the grammar model.
Ready to update the current directory
Waiting for a network connection or retry…
One regular expression per line, protecting existing files. Removing a rule allows matching resources to be replaced. Runtime databases and sync data are always protected.
Optional, encrypted with the device key. Used only for GitHub API requests to increase the quota; never sent to file download URLs.

Choose from the official catalog. Files are converted for the selected edition and saved in dicts. Pro uses the downloaded or existing zi.pro character table. To enable a dictionary, reference it in the main dictionary’s import_tables.
